root: Uni-CLI 0.225.0 is the universal computer-control platform release: intent, policy, action substrates, evidence, delivery, and repair across real software.
`architecture audit` now emits `capability_matrix` and `workflow_readiness` so agents can inspect control surfaces and vehicle-assistant workflows without pretending catalog coverage is live proof.
Core Commander commands now project into the same command-contract family as adapter commands, making compute, browser, delivery, runs, MCP, agents, and architecture first-class control operations.
`unicli do` now emits a delivery spec template for executable matches while preserving explicit execution through `unicli delivery run`.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.225.0 是 universal computer-control platform 发布：意图、策略、行动 substrate、证据、交付、修复，覆盖真实软件。
`architecture audit` 现在输出 `capability_matrix` 和 `workflow_readiness`，让 Agent 能审计控制面和智驾类 workflow，同时不把 catalog 覆盖伪装成 live proof。
Core Commander 命令现在和 adapter 命令进入同一套 command-contract family，compute、browser、delivery、runs、MCP、agents、architecture 都是一等控制操作。
`unicli do` 现在为可执行匹配输出 delivery spec template，但真实执行仍需要显式 `unicli delivery run`。
